تقتصدي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِدِي (taqtaṣidī) /taq.ta.sˤi.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
# تُقْتَصَدِي (tuqtaṣadī) /tuq.ta.sˤa.diː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَدَ (iqtaṣada)
